node.question: Can the source mug be reliably matched to an edited object, and what visible continuity cues support that match?
node.criteria: Pass only if visible identity or continuity evidence reliably links the source mug to a specific edited object and permits its position to be judged. Report the source mug's distinctive shape, handle, color, and scale against each plausible edited object; do not treat mere scene continuity or a plausible location as a match.
